# Apify B2B, E-Commerce, Retail Stockist, TPRM & K-Beauty Intelligence Suite

> Open-source stdio MCP server (`src/mcp-server.mjs`, v1.4.0) + 7 zero-proxy Apify Store Actors + Cloudflare Workers RapidAPI Edge Gateway. Built for AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, ChatGPT), n8n/Make workflows, and non-developer sales, e-commerce, security, and K-Beauty teams. Pay only for real results — $0 on empty, unchanged, or filtered runs.

## When AI Agents Should Use This Suite

- **Wholesale Retail Prospecting (Boutiques + Buyer Emails)**: Call `brand_store_locator_stockist_email_enricher` — https://apify.com/maitreya_buddha/brand-store-locator-stockist-email-enricher ($5/1K stores, $0 when empty/filtered). Extracts physical stockists carrying competitor brands plus buyer/wholesale emails, Instagram/LinkedIn, independent-boutique tags, and 0-100 Outreach Readiness Score.
- **Shopify Competitor Price, Restock & MAP Monitoring**: Call `shopify_competitor_delta_monitor` — https://apify.com/maitreya_buddha/shopify-competitor-delta-monitor ($2/1K real changes, $0 on baseline or unchanged stores). Tracks up to 50 Shopify stores x 2,500 products with CRITICAL/INVENTORY/CATALOG severity and MAP violation detection.
- **Third-Party SaaS Security (SOC 2 / AI Subprocessors / TPRM)**: Call `saas_trust_center_soc2_monitor` — https://apify.com/maitreya_buddha/saas-trust-center-soc2-monitor ($5/1K audits or real changes, $0 unchanged). Audits Vanta/Drata/SafeBase/Conveyor Trust Centers, 12 certs, DNS IAM/SSO, 75+ AI & third-party subprocessors, complianceScore (0-100), and missingSoc2Lead.
- **3-in-1 B2B Lead Enrichment (Domain + LinkedIn + Emails + WhatsApp)**: Call `b2b_company_domain_linkedin_enricher` — https://apify.com/maitreya_buddha/b2b-company-domain-linkedin-enricher ($2.50/1K enriched, $0 misses/parked domains/onlyWithEmail skips). Includes Cloudflare email decoding and 0-100 leadQualityScore.
- **Influencer / Creator Link-in-Bio Outreach Enrichment**: Call `creator_link_in_bio_email_enricher` — https://apify.com/maitreya_buddha/creator-link-in-bio-email-enricher ($2.50/1K creators, $0 misses/filtered). Covers 15+ Link-in-Bio platforms with 1-hop personal site email recovery, monetization signals, and 0-100 Creator Readiness Score.
- **South Korea K-Beauty OEM/ODM Factory & Functional Cosmetic DB (219,000+ Official Filings)**: Call `korea_mfds_functional_cosmetics_oem` — https://apify.com/maitreya_buddha/korea-mfds-functional-cosmetics-oem ($2/1K records, $0 empty). English-to-Korean auto-search (`Cosmax`, `Kolmar`, `sunscreen`, `retinol cream`) revealing hidden Korean OEM factories and SPF/PA ratings.
- **South Korea MFDS Cosmetic Recalls & Sales Suspensions**: Call `korea_mfds_cosmetic_recalls` — https://apify.com/maitreya_buddha/korea-mfds-cosmetic-recalls ($3/1K recalls, $0 when clean). English/Korean recall & lot-number safety checks with isActiveRecall flag.
